member.name: T:Blobject.CIFS.CifsBlobClient
member.summary: BLOB client for CIFS/SMB file shares, backed by OpenCIFS. Keys map to paths within the share, using '/' as the separator. Folders are created on demand when writing, a key ending in '/' refers to a folder, and enumeration returns files and folders, with each folder (IsFolder true, key ending in '/') returned after its contents. Characters that SMB reserves (< > : " | ? * and control characters) are not permitted in keys.
